meta.title: Executive Workshops | Leadership Academy | Cyrrus
meta.description: Leadership Academy: executive workshops and management training that sustain CIRA's Adoption phase. AI workshop for executives, business innovation, ISO 27001, and business continuity (DRP).

hub.serviceDescription: Executive workshops and organizational change management
hub.serviceDetail: Executive management training and organizational change management that sustains the CIRA method's Adoption phase.

hero.title: Executive workshops and organizational change management
hero.description: The project ends, the consultant leaves, and three months later the team is back to working the way it did before. We train the client's team to operate under the same AI governance model Cyrrus implements, so speed doesn't depend on us still being there.

ia-para-directivos.title: AI Workshop for Executives
ia-para-directivos.shortDescription: AI decisions by instinct, not criteria
ia-para-directivos.intro: The committee approves or rejects AI initiatives by instinct, not by criteria, because no one has translated the technical concepts into questions leadership can actually evaluate.
body: A hands-on workshop for executives to understand what to ask, what to validate, and what risks to evaluate before approving any AI initiative — no prior technical training required.
It connects directly to the corporate AI governance we design at Cyrrus Intelligence Lab, so leadership training and technical architecture speak the same language.

innovacion-empresarial.title: Business Innovation Workshop
innovacion-empresarial.intro: There's an innovation budget and no way to decide where to invest it without chasing the latest trend.
body: We work with the leadership team on a prioritization framework that avoids chasing trends and instead ties every innovation initiative to measurable business impact.
The workshop draws on the same diagnostic approach we use in the CIRA method's Strategy phase.

iso-27001.title: ISO 27001 Training for Companies
iso-27001.intro: A major client requires ISO 27001 certification and no one in the organization knows where to start.
body: We prepare leadership and IT teams on ISO 27001 fundamentals, focused on how they directly apply to the company's data and AI governance.
It complements the cybersecurity solution evaluation we do in the CIRA method's Solution Selection phase.

continuidad-de-negocio-drp.title: Business Continuity Workshop (DRP)
continuidad-de-negocio-drp.shortDescription: A DRP that's never been tested
continuidad-de-negocio-drp.intro: You've never tested what happens if the main system goes down on a Monday at 9am — and a continuity plan that's never tested isn't a plan.
body: A business continuity plan that's never been tested isn't a plan. This workshop guides teams through designing and rehearsing their disaster recovery plan (DRP) with real scenarios.
Ideal for organizations that have migrated or are migrating critical infrastructure to the cloud.

gestion-del-cambio-para-lideres.title: Change Management for Leaders
gestion-del-cambio-para-lideres.shortDescription: Adoption that doesn't survive the consultant leaving
gestion-del-cambio-para-lideres.intro: Middle managers quietly boycott every new initiative, and adoption collapses as soon as Cyrrus steps back.
body: We train the client's internal leaders on the same change management tools we apply during a project, so adoption holds after Cyrrus steps back.
This workshop is the natural extension of the CIRA method's Adoption phase into the internal leadership team.

gobierno-de-datos-para-ejecutivos.title: Data Governance for Executives
gobierno-de-datos-para-ejecutivos.shortDescription: Every area with its own number
gobierno-de-datos-para-ejecutivos.intro: Every area defends its own version of the correct figure, and boards end up debating which number is the real one.
body: A workshop for leadership to understand their real role in data governance: what to decide personally, what to delegate, and with what controls to do it with confidence.
It connects to the enterprise AI architecture we define at Cyrrus Intelligence Lab.

liderazgo-digital-y-toma-de-decisiones.title: Digital Leadership & Decision-Making
liderazgo-digital-y-toma-de-decisiones.intro: The committee decides with the same instincts as ten years ago, now applied to AI and digital transformation decisions.
body: We work with the leadership team on the critical pacing, prioritization, and quality decisions that determine whether a digital transformation project lands successfully.
A natural capstone for leaders who've already gone through Leadership Academy's AI, innovation, and change management workshops.
